bullets.section: What I’m drinking this holiday season
bullets.title: BLÅ
bullets.note:
from** [**Sparkling Tea**](https://sparklingtea.co/)**.** This stuff is exceptionally delicious, and a good Danish name makes everything feel a tad fancier. The bottle I’m opening tonight has jasmine, white tea, and Darjeeling tea as notes, but my favorite is probably the Oolong tea blend.  
​  
BLÅ is an alcohol-free aperitif that truly tastes great, not like a poor replacement. Sparkling Tea provides [a locator](https://sparklingtea.co/buy-it-here/) to help you find online and brick-and-mortar options that carry it. As always, probably best to call ahead to confirm it’s in stock before trekking to your local store.

bullets.title: What if Readers Like A.I.-Generated Fiction?
bullets.creator: Vauhini Vara, Pulitzer Prize for Fiction finalist
bullets.note:
(_The New Yorker_) by [Vauhini Vara](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vauhini_Vara), Pulitzer Prize for Fiction finalist. ([Alternate link](https://archive.is/nB4cu#selection-869.536-869.877).) From the article:  
​  
​_Even if the A.I. model could create prose that passed for mine, that didn’t mean it could invent the content. Plus, there remained an enormous gap between a good sentence and a good novel. Still, I couldn’t avoid the truth. Seven excellent readers had mistaken an A.I. model for me. Seven excellent readers had mistaken me for an A.I. model._

bullets.section: What I’m doing over the weekend
bullets.title: 2025 Past Year Review
bullets.note: I’m sometimes asked how I approach New Year’s resolutions. The truth is that I no longer approach them at all, even though I did for decades. Why? I have found “past year reviews” (PYR) more valuable and actionable than half-blindly looking forward. [Here’s the step-by-step process I follow](https://tim.blog/2021/12/27/past-year-review/?utm_campaign=5bf&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_source=convertkit). For a fun pairing, also read “[I’ve Done Tim Ferriss’s Past Year Review for 5 Years. Here Are 22 Lessons I Learned](https://medium.com/@chriscordry/ive-done-tim-ferriss-s-past-year-review-for-5-years-here-are-22-lessons-i-learned-cfd0fb0492a1)” by [Chris Cordry](https://medium.com/@chriscordry). ([Alternate link](https://web.archive.org/web/20221210070222/https://medium.com/@chriscordry/ive-done-tim-ferriss-s-past-year-review-for-5-years-here-are-22-lessons-i-learned-cfd0fb0492a1).)
